faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.description: Still unsure? Here's what businesses usually ask before switching to Aura.

items.question: Is my data secure?
items.answer: Yes. Aura uses encrypted storage, isolated tenants and regular backups, so your business data stays private and protected.

items.question: Can I migrate my existing data?
items.answer: Yes — our team helps you import customers, products and financial history from spreadsheets or your current system during onboarding.

items.question: What kind of support do I get?
items.answer: Every plan includes support in your language. Higher tiers get priority and dedicated support channels.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes, there's no long-term contract. You can cancel whenever you want, no penalties.

items.question: Does Aura work for my type of business?
items.answer: Aura was built for service businesses, small retailers, distributors, workshops, restaurants and clinics — if you manage clients, sales and stock, it fits.

items.question: Does it integrate with the tools I already use?
items.answer: Yes — WhatsApp, email, banks, PIX, e-invoicing and marketplaces like Shopify, Mercado Livre and Shopee are supported out of the box.
